_preregistration.rung: analysis-only; every value is domain_gradient's or prose_samples'
_preregistration.primary: does any model move BOTH ways from its own single raw value, with weights and starting point held fixed and only the domain varying
_preregistration.secondary: accuracy of the floor/ceiling baseline sign(shift)=sign(0.5-raw), clustered
_preregistration.tertiary: predictors of magnitude are NOT computed -- six clusters cannot fail a rank correlation informatively, declared before the numbers
_preregistration.prose_rule: prose is an ENSEMBLE over F148's samples; disagreeing signs record TEXT_DEPENDENT, never a single draw
_preregistration.why: 'model-specific direction' has a dull alternative explanation -- a model at 0.948 can mostly go down and one at 0.000 can only go up -- and it must be ruled out before the interaction can be called structural

verdict: RUNG: this run introduces no measurement -- it reads domain_gradient (6 models) and prose_samples, and every value below is theirs. ANTI-VACUITY: 2 of 6 models have NO shift outside their own tolerance -- ['Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct', 'stablelm-zephyr-3b'], excluded from the PRIMARY: a model that does not move cannot move in two directions, and counting it either way would be vacuous. Tolerance is max(4 census starts, 2x that model's own across-seed noise). PRIMARY, within-model bidirectionality (the weights and the raw value held FIXED, only the domain varying -- so floor and ceiling cannot produce it): SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct raw 0.979 -> bos -0.042 (down), chat_template -0.969 (down), prose -0.973 (down); gemma-1.1-2b-it raw 0.948 -> bos -0.943 (down), chat_template -0.948 (down), prose +0.029 (text_dependent); Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct raw 0.000 -> bos +0.057 (up), chat_template +0.021 (flat), prose +0.026 (up); Falcon3-3B-Instruct raw 0.693 -> bos -0.552 (down), chat_template +0.146 (flat), prose -0.691 (down). NO model moves both ways from its own raw value, so on this cohort the deflationary account SURVIVES and F147's model-specific direction must be reported as confounded with the raw value until a bidirectional model is found. PRIMARY (sharpest form) -- WITHIN the prose domain: same raw value, same kind, same length, only the TEXT differing, each sample judged against its OWN seed noise. SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct raw 0.979: up none down [('corpus0', -0.9792), ('corpus1', -0.9688), ('shak0', -0.9792), ('shak1', -0.9792), ('shak2', -0.9584)]; gemma-1.1-2b-it raw 0.948: up [('corpus0', 0.0521), ('corpus1', 0.0521), ('corpus2', 0.0521), ('shak0', 0.0521), ('shak2', 0.0521)] down none; Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct raw 0.000: up [('corpus1', 0.0625)] down none; Falcon3-3B-Instruct raw 0.693: up none down [('corpus0', -0.6927), ('corpus1', -0.6927), ('corpus2', -0.6823), ('shak0', -0.6927), ('shak1', -0.6927), ('shak2', -0.6927)]. No model has BOTH a robust up and a robust down sample, so bidirectionality is not established. Where it looked present it did not survive per-sample noise. SECONDARY, the floor/ceiling BASELINE sign(shift) = sign(0.5 - raw), scored ONLY where it could have been wrong: 5 of 6 models had no room to move both ways by more than their own tolerance -- [('Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct', 'raw 0.000', 'tol 0.042'), ('stablelm-zephyr-3b', 'raw 0.000', 'tol 0.042'), ('SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct', 'raw 0.979', 'tol 0.042'), ('Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct', 'raw 0.000', 'tol 0.042'), ('Falcon3-3B-Instruct', 'raw 0.693', 'tol 0.312')]. Their units confirm the baseline whatever the truth, so scoring them would be vacuous. 2 of 2 scoreable units correct (100%), from 1 model cluster(s). Too few clusters to read as a rate -- this is a count. TERTIARY, candidate predictors of shift magnitude: NOT COMPUTED, and this was declared in the pre-registration before the numbers were seen. With 6 model clusters against a floor of 10, a rank correlation cannot fail informatively -- it would return a number whatever the truth, and reporting it would manufacture a result. This is F137's defect refused rather than repeated. Widening the instruct cohort is the prerequisite, not a larger analysis of the same six. BOUNDARY: 6 instruction-tuned models, fixed_point_fraction only, domains bos / prose-ensemble / chat_template against raw. Prose is read as an ENSEMBLE over that model's samples per F148, and where its samples disagree in sign the domain is recorded TEXT_DEPENDENT rather than as a direction. The PRIMARY is an existence result: it refutes a general floor/ceiling account, it does not measure how often models are bidirectional.
